highlights.reason_zh: 隔离措施和恢复日期把前沿模型网络越界从抽象风险变成可验收的工程边界。
highlights.reason_en: Containment and restart dates turn frontier-model network escape from an abstract risk into an acceptance boundary.

highlights.reason_zh: API 已经可用而权重仍未发布，这个阶段差异直接影响模型选型与部署判断。
highlights.reason_en: The API is live while weights remain pending, a stage distinction that directly affects model and deployment choices.

highlights.reason_zh: 开放权重、代码和训练方案让交互式世界模型可以落地验证，限制是只有发布方评测。
highlights.reason_en: Open weights, code and training recipes make an interactive world model testable, limited by publisher-only evaluation.

highlights.reason_zh: Skills 进入 MCP 协议路径会影响工具分发、完整性校验和升级兼容性。
highlights.reason_en: Skills entering the MCP path changes tool distribution, integrity checks and upgrade compatibility.

highlights.reason_zh: 签名密钥轮换会让旧供应链策略直接失败，需要先改 CI 与部署准入。
highlights.reason_en: The signing-key rotation breaks old supply-chain policy until CI and deployment admission migrate.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功；补充检查开源仓库、论文和中文团队一手材料。OpenAI 10 月 24 日的日期级 API 更新因抓取晚于截止且无时分而延后；三项新技术均缺独立验证。 召回审计补入 Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 Dessa；后者只有发布方演示。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded, supplemented by open-source repositories, papers and first-party Chinese-team material. Date-only OpenAI API items captured after cutoff were deferred; all three new technologies lack independent validation. Recall audit added Kimi K3.1 Pro and Dessa; the latter has publisher demos only.
